scripts.build: vite build && vite build --ssr src/entry-server.jsx --outDir .ssr && node scripts/prerender.mjs
scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests vite.config.js eslint.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests vite.config.js eslint.config.js playwright.config.js package.json
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests vite.config.js eslint.config.js playwright.config.js package.json
